name: SDN Host Clock Node
description: Capability node wrapping the host clock hostcall group (clock.now + clock.nowIso). Method "now" takes no input and emits one "time" frame of UTF-8 JSON bytes {"unixMs":N,"iso":"..."} sampled from the host clock at invoke time. PERIODIC emission is a flow TRIGGER concern (timer trigger kind), not this node: wire a timer trigger at the flow level and place this node downstream when a flow needs the sampled time as data. Host gating: the Go node (sdn-server modulert) serves clock.* as ungated built-ins; the SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost are default-deny and require the "clock" capability grant, so this node declares it for host-agnostic flows.

externalInterfaces.description: Host clock hostcalls (clock.now unix milliseconds, clock.nowIso RFC3339). Available on the Go server host (built-in) and SDK NodeHost/BrowserHost (capability-gated).

acceptedTypeSets.description: Optional trigger frame; the payload is ignored. Any frame (e.g. a timer-trigger emission or an upstream completion signal) causes one clock sample.
UTF-8 JSON bytes (aligned-binary wire format): {"unixMs":<integer unix milliseconds from clock.now>,"iso":"<RFC3339 string from clock.nowIso>"}.

outputPorts.description: The sampled host time as a JSON frame.

methods.description: Samples clock.now and clock.nowIso through the sync hostcall bridge and emits both readings in one JSON frame.
